messages:
Priya: Quick Q1 OKR milestone sync — drop what shipped / what slipped and owner for each milestone. I’ll consolidate by EOD. Focus: infra, runtime, embeddings.
Mateo: Runtime-v2 canary deployed yesterday, staggered rollout started (20% prod). Owner: Mateo. Note: saw ~5% latency regression on 512-token traces.
Lin: Runtime lead here — canary -> prod 20% yes. Follow-ups: perf PR #482 needs review, and docs PR #300 for rollout checklist. Also we need a changelog entry.
Jess: Jess (SRE) — I’ll review #482 today. Suggest we freeze autoscale policy while we validate, otherwise rollbacks get messy. @Mateo can you patch the autoscale config?
Mateo: Yep will patch the policy and post config diff. Pushing a tiny revertable change to disable burst scaling for 2 hours during validation.
Omar: Omar (QA) — regression tests flagged a tokenization flake for long sequences: `tests/integration/tokenize_long.py` failing 2/10 runs. Owner: Omar + runtime eng. Priority: P1 for next 48h.
Lin: Seen that. Root cause looks like boundary condition in tokenizer streaming path. I’ll PR a fix later today.
Casey: Embeddings pipeline update — slipped. Vectorizer rewrite blocked by schema change from DataEng. Owner: Casey + Priya + DataEng. New ETA: next Wed. Impact: search relevance testing delayed, production embed generation still on fallback.
Priya: Acknowledged. Casey, can you post a short impact matrix in the thread (who sees degraded perf/features)?
Casey: Will do — quick summary: customers on experimental indexer unaffected, ingestion backlog increased for new parity feature, internal eval jobs delayed.
Alex: Design note — the new tool-call UI change shipped to 12% in beta. Need copy sign-off and small alignment with product copy. @Priya can you sign off by 3pm?
Priya: I’ll review and sign off by 3pm.
Lin: Quick CR ping round: please review runtime PRs #480 and #482, and docs PR #300. If you can do a quick scan, add :eyes: reaction and a line of review. Trying to avoid blocking rollout.
Jess: :thumbsup: I’ll add infra comments on #482 after smoke runs.
Omar: QA will prioritize tests for #480/#482 under the release label `rq/runtime-v2`.
deploy-bot: deploy started prod/runtime-v2 @ 2026-03-10T14:02Z — canary -> 20% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled.
Priya: Summary / next steps: 1) Runtime perf regression — Mateo+Lin+Jess to own (patch autoscale + perf PR) 2) Tokenizer flake — Lin/Omar fix + test by EOD 3) Embeddings rewrite slipped — Casey to post impact matrix + new ETA Wed 4) CRs: everyone please review #480/#482/#300 today. I’ll consolidate and share an owners table in the doc.
Mateo: logging action: I’ll post the autoscale config diff and rollout rollback playbook in #eng-runtime.
Lin: Will open a small hotfix PR for tokenizer in ~2hrs, tagging QA.
Priya: Thanks all — I’ll post the consolidated owners table in product docs and ping again when ready. :rocket:
